alias_rules.dual_wield: paired weapon item occupies both hands

metadata.stacking: Stackables occupy inventory but not equipment slots.
metadata.loot_selection: Filter by loot_pools, level_required, then apply rarity weights to eligible items. If a selected rarity has no eligible items, reroll among nonempty eligible rarities. Quest items never enter random rolls.
metadata.stat_semantics: Flat core stats in stats; non-core modifiers, resistances, procs, and resource effects in human-readable effects pending combat-system definitions. CRIT flat value assumed percentage points, to be confirmed.
metadata.rarity_multiplier_note: Suggested for future scaling; NOT pre-applied to listed stat values.
notes: No meshes, icons, UV maps, animation bindings, or paths are assigned.
Gold values, levels, rarities and drop weights are new proposals.
Effect definitions must be converted to engine-specific IDs once combat/status system is settled.
Set effects are inactive design proposals, not engine-ready combat scripts.
